Title: Valeera Hotfix Patch
Subtitle: Hotfix
CleanedNotes:
=== Heroes: Kael'thas ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that could cause Pyroblast to move unpredictably when fired at a target that enters and exits the mines.
  • Fixed an issue that could cause Pyroblast's targeting indicator to persist indefinitely when targeting a Hero as they become Unrevealable.

=== Heroes: Nazeebo ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • The Corpse Spiders vase will no longer fall through the terrain when the Ability does not hit any enemies at its landing location.

=== Heroes: Ragnaros ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Activating Empower Sulfuras will no longer cause Ragnaros to lose his current target if that target was automatically acquired during attack-move command.
  • Catching Fire's Talent and Quest Progress tooltips now each state that Ragnaros gains 1.5 Health Regeneration per Regeneration Globe he gathers.

=== Heroes: Zagara ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Mutalisks will now correctly fly around or over unpathable terrain.

Heroes: Kael\u0027thas: • Fixed an issue that could cause Pyroblast to move unpredictably when fired at a target that enters and exits the mines.
• Fixed an issue that could cause Pyroblast's targeting indicator to persist indefinitely when targeting a Hero as they become Unrevealable.

Heroes: Ragnaros: • Activating Empower Sulfuras will no longer cause Ragnaros to lose his current target if that target was automatically acquired during attack-move command.
• Catching Fire's Talent and Quest Progress tooltips now each state that Ragnaros gains 1.5 Health Regeneration per Regeneration Globe he gathers.
